_comment: Teaching/lore NPC on the actor model (plan-entity-model.md chunk 3a) — formerly a statless model/npc type placed from zone.npcs, now an ordinary actor carrying an interaction block. role creature + speed 0 (PO 2026-07-27, D4): an NPC is an actor that authors no movement, not a kind of its own. Unattackable by two AUTHORED knobs (D5): faction townsfolk (friendlyToPlayers ⇒ player damage skips it) and collisionLayer 97 = PlayerStatic(1) + Viewport(32) + MobStatic(64) — solid and streamed, but deliberately NOT on Action(2), so no aura on either side can target it. aggroRadius 1.0 is the pre-merge zone radius verbatim and IS the interaction range (D7 ⇒ interaction.range omitted). experience 0 keeps it off the nameplate path; the health bar is accepted (D3). All values [PLACEHOLDER]. Teaches Recover and SummonTotem. Shares the Hermit sprite (entityType override).
name: Shaman

lines: Let nature guide you. But also be aware of nature. It's complicated.

options.blockedLine: I see great potential in you! Come back later and I might have something for you.

grants.line: Nature mends what it can. Breathe, and let this close your wounds.
